checkbox_map.track: Track 3: Behavior Tree Builder & Deterministic Divergence Function
checkbox_map.original_text: Added `build_paired_bts(metadata, data_dir, config) -> BatchBuildResult` in `parser/pipeline.py`. It accepts `Sequence[MetadataRow]` and `CompressionConfig`, reuses `build_paired_bt()`, and returns ordered `trees` and `errors` tuples. Each input pair produces exactly one tree or a `PairBuildError` containing its ID, source filenames, exception type, and message. Metadata CSV errors still raise from `read_metadata_csv()` before batch construction.

checkbox_map.track: Track 3: Behavior Tree Builder & Deterministic Divergence Function
checkbox_map.original_text: Added `align_subtask_samples(node: SubtaskBT) -> AlignedSubtask` in `parser/divergence.py`. It returns the shared progress grid, failure-run absolute timestamps, and success/failure arrays for every `TelemetryFeature`; scalar shapes are `(n,)`, vector shapes `(n, components)`. Interpolation is linear for continuous features, previous-value for gripper closure, and normalized/sign-aligned shortest-path SLERP for quaternions. A singleton stays constant over its partner's grid; two singletons compare once at progress zero. Queries within `1e-12` progress of an observed sample snap to that sample to avoid roundoff-induced transitions; the grid remains the unrounded sorted union. Inputs are not mutated, and interpolated values are comparisons rather than new observations.

checkbox_map.track: Track 3: Behavior Tree Builder & Deterministic Divergence Function
checkbox_map.original_text: Implement deterministic **within-subtask alignment**: stages followed by a transition use `u=(t-t_start)/(t_end-t_start)` and the union of retained progress values; the final observed stage uses common stage-relative elapsed time without extrapolation, including when failure reached the final expected stage. Unobserved stages are explicitly not comparable. Interpolate continuous features linearly, use previous-value closure and normalized/sign-aligned shortest-path quaternion interpolation. Never cross stage boundaries. Keep observed durations separate from sensor deltas. See the parser handoff for coordinate, singleton, and numerical-tolerance rules.

checkbox_map.track: Track 3: Behavior Tree Builder & Deterministic Divergence Function
checkbox_map.original_text: Define and implement `delta_f(u)=max_j(abs(failure_f,j(u)-success_f,j(u)))` (one component for scalars), then `max_abs_deltas[f]=max_u(delta_f(u))` for all `TelemetryFeature` values. Quaternion deltas are dimensionless component differences after sign alignment, not radians. First divergence is the earliest grid point strictly exceeding a configured per-feature threshold, mapped back to the **failure run's absolute timestamp**. Keep paired-trace thresholds separate from compression's adjacent-row thresholds; identical traces produce zero deltas and null onset.
